definitions.explanation: Any medication taken to treat stomach problems such as indigestion, heartburn, nausea, or stomach pain.

examples.japanese: {食|た}べすぎて{胃|い}が{痛|いた}いから、{胃薬|いぐすり}を{買|か}ってきて。
examples.english: I ate too much and my stomach hurts, so go buy me some stomach medicine.

examples.japanese: {旅行|りょこう}の{時|とき}は{念|ねん}のため{胃薬|いぐすり}を{持|も}っていくようにしている。
examples.english: When I travel, I make sure to bring stomach medicine just in case.

notes:
A compound of {胃|い} (stomach) + {薬|くすり} (medicine), with sequential voicing (rendaku) producing ぐすり. A practical everyday word known to all Japanese speakers.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {胃薬|いぐすり}を{飲|の}む: to take stomach medicine
- {胃薬|いぐすり}を{買|か}う: to buy stomach medicine
- {市販|しはん}の{胃薬|いぐすり}: over-the-counter stomach medicine

RELATED WORDS:
- {頭痛薬|ずつうやく}: headache medicine
- {風邪薬|かぜぐすり}: cold medicine
- {胃腸薬|いちょうやく}: gastrointestinal medicine — a broader category that includes intestinal remedies
